set system host-name [parameter1].explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set system authentication-order [paramet.explanation: Configure the authentication order of the system.

set system radius-server [parameter1].explanation: Configures a RADIUS server with the specified parameters, such as IP address, port, and shared secret, for network authentication and accounting purposes.

secret [parameter2].explanation: Configure IP addresses and shared keys for RADIGUS servers.

parameters.name: secret
parameters.explanation: A shared key to communicating with the RADIGUS server.

set routing-options static route [parame.explanation: This command configures a static route in the routing table, where `[parameter1]` specifies the destination network prefix and its next-hop or discard/ reject behavior.

next-hop [parameter2].explanation: This command configures a static route in Junos, where `[parameter1]` is the destination network and `[parameter2]` specifies the next-hop IP address for forwarding traffic.

set routing-options multicast mroute [pa.explanation: The command configures a static multicast route (mroute) in Junos, specifying the multicast group or source address in `[parameter1]` for routing multicast traffic.

parameters.name: mroute
parameters.explanation: The target network address and subnet mask for multicast routing.

to [parameter2].explanation: The command `to [parameter2]` in Junos specifies the destination or target for an operation, such as routing or forwarding, to the value provided in `[parameter2]`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.explanation: The next-hop address for multicast routing.

set firewall family inet filter [paramet.command: set firewall family inet filter list1
set firewall family inet filter [paramet.explanation: This command fragment configures an IPv4 firewall filter named `[parameter1]` in Junos OS, defining rules to control traffic based on specified conditions.

term [parameter2].explanation: This command fragment creates a term within an IPv4 firewall filter, where `[parameter1]` is the filter name and `[parameter2]` is the term name.

from source-address [parameter3].explanation: The command filters traffic based on the specified source IP address (`[parameter3]`) in a Junos policy or rule.

then [parameter3].explanation: Configure firewall filter terminologies and accept all traffic.

parameters.name: action
parameters.explanation: Action, accept indicates acceptance of traffic.

unit [parameter2].explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

family inet address [parameter3]/[parame.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.
